publishedMetadata.title: Dynamic field arrays
publishedMetadata.description: Preserve field-array identity with fields[].id, controlled append/remove, and bounded dynamic inputs. This guided lab analyzes and repairs a real React Hook Form state or submission failure.
objectives: Preserve field-array identity with fields[].id, controlled append/remove, and bounded dynamic inputs.
Type unique values in three rows; remove the middle row. The remaining values must match their original logical items. Adding past eight rows must be disabled.
Never accept arbitrary numbers of dynamic rows on the server; cap collection lengths and validate each nested item.
rubric: Preserve field-array identity with fields[].id, controlled append/remove, and bounded dynamic inputs.
Type unique values in three rows; remove the middle row. The remaining values must match their original logical items. Adding past eight rows must be disabled.
I can explain why client validation is not server authorization.
